'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Thirteen [[Allied Democratic Forces]] terrorists are arrested in [[Rwanda]] after planning multiple [[bombing]] attacks in [[Kigali]]. The planned attacks came as Rwanda is helping [[Mozambique]] fighting [[Islamic State|ISIL]]-linked groups in the [[Insurgency in Cabo Delgado]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2021/10/01/rwanda-arrests-13-suspected-of-plotting-terrorist-attacks/ (Africa News)]
*[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
**A bomb targets a [[Taliban]] security forces vehicle, injuring five people. Soldiers raided an [[Islamic State – Khorasan Province|ISIL-K]] hideout after the attack, killing several terrorists and arresting a few more. [https://tolonews.com/afghanistan-174877 (TOLO News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*Aftermath of the [[Fall of Kabul (2021)|Fall of Kabul]]
**It is announced that the [[Afghanistan]] pavilion at [[Expo 2020]] in [[Dubai]] will remain closed to visitors due to the [[Taliban]] [[2021 Taliban offensive|takeover]] of the country. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/afghan-pavilion-dubai-world-fair-stays-shut-after-taliban-takeover-2021-10-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of Venezuela]]
**[[Venezuela]] launches its second monetary overhaul in the past three years by cutting six zeros from its [[Venezuelan bolivar|currency]] in order to simplify accounting. This move was in response to [[hyperinflation]], which reached an annual record of 1,743%, amid [[Crisis in Venezuela|a serious ongoing economic crisis]]. [https://en.mercopress.com/2021/10/01/fear-reigns-among-venezuelans-as-six-more-zeros-are-to-be-removed-from-local-currency (MercoPress)]
*[[Russia]]n gas supplies via the [[Yamal–Europe pipeline]] fall almost 77% in a single day, raising European gas prices to an all-time high. [[European Parliament]] lawmakers request investigations of market manipulation, although [[Gazprom]]'s exports outside the former Soviet Union rose 15.3% year on year in the first nine months of 2021 and [[Germany|German]] utility [[Uniper]] confirms that Russia was fulfilling its contractual obligations. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/european-gas-prices-hit-all-time-highs-russian-flows-slump-2021-10-01/ (Reuters)] [https://www.rferl.org/a/natural-gas-prices-record-highs/31488196.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] grants the conditional approval of the [[Sinovac]] [[Coronavac]] vaccine for children aged above 12. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2021/10/01/covid-19-sinovac-vaccine-approved-for-those-aged-12-and-above (''The Star'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Bermuda]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****The [[Philippines]] adds the [[British territory]] of [[Bermuda]] to its red list due to COVID-19. Bermuda became the first British territory to be added to the Asian country's red list. [https://philippineslifestyle.com/bermuda-ph-red-list-october-15/ (PLS)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 2,909 new cases of [[COVID-19]], thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 99,430. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/8-seniors-die-of-covid-19-bringing-death-toll-to-103-in-spore-2909-new-cases (''The Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] lifts a nearly six-week [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] to contain the spread of COVID-19 but continues to maintain a night curfew and a ban on public gatherings and parties as the number of cases declines. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/sri-lanka-lifts-lockdown-retains-curfew-at-night/article36783784.ece (''The Hindu'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****[[Greece]] imposes a curfew and bans music at bars, cafés and restaurants in [[Thessaloniki]], [[Larissa, Greece|Larissa]], [[Chalkidiki]] and [[Kilkis]] due to an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases in the region. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1168893/covid-curfew-for-thessaloniki/ (''Ekathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports a record for the fourth consecutive day of 887 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|death]]s from COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 208,142. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2021/10/01/russia-breaks-covid-deaths-record-for-fourth-day-straight-a75188 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
*****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York City]]
******[[Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States|Associate Justice]] [[Sonia Sotomayor]] rejects an order to block the vaccine mandate for [[New York City]] schoolteachers and employees. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/supreme-court/sotomayor-declines-block-vaccine-mandate-new-york-city-public-school-n1280610 (CBS News)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[Governor of California|California Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] announces that [[California]] will become the first [[U.S. state]] to mandate [[COVID-19 vaccine|COVID-19 vaccines]] for all students in schools. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/covid-vaccine-mandate-california-students/ (CBS News)]
***The [[United States]] surpasses 700,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-covid-19-death-toll-hits-700000-2021-10-01/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Argentina]]
***[[Argentina]] authorizes the approval of the [[Sinopharm COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 3 and 11 years. Health minister [[Carla Vizzotti]] announces that Argentina will end the year with all of its population over the age of 3 years vaccinated against COVID-19. [https://www.eluniverso.com/noticias/internacional/vacuna-sinopharm-es-aprobada-en-argentina-para-infantes-de-3-a-11-anos-nota/ (''El Universo'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[Australia]] expands eligibility for the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech]] and [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] COVID-19 vaccines to include seniors over the age of 60 who had previously only been eligible for the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca vaccine]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/sep/30/pfizer-and-moderna-covid-vaccines-now-available-to-all-australians-over-60 (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Deployment of COVID-19 vaccines]]
***It is announced that more than 50 countries have missed the [[World Health Organization]]'s (WHO) target for 10% of their populations to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19 by the end of September. Most of these countries are in [[Africa]], where the WHO's overall figure for fully vaccinated populations is currently 4.4%. [https://www.bbc.com/news/56100076 (BBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Post-Brexit United Kingdom relations with the European Union]]
**[[British Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] says that the contentious arrangements regarding the [[Northern Irish Protocol]] could work in principle if they were "fixed" but warns the [[European Union]] that they could be "ditched" if they do not work. Johnson adds that this is a problem that "the United Kingdom did not want". [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/fix-it-or-ditch-it-uks-johnson-warns-eu-nireland-deal-2021-10-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Murder of Cécile Bloch]]
**The [[suicide note]] left by [[François Vérove]], a 59-year-old [[French people|French]] former [[military police]] officer who committed [[suicide in France|suicide]] two days ago in [[Le Grau-du-Roi]], [[Occitanie]], reveals that he [[murder]]ed four people, including 11-year-old Cécile Bloch. The [[serial killer]], nicknamed ''Le Grêlé'', was also involved in a series of [[rapes]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/10/1/french-ex-policeman-leaves-serial-killer-suicide-confession-note (Al Jazeera)]
*[[September 2021 Guayaquil prison riot]]
**[[Ecuador]] says it will [[pardon]] more than 2,000 inmates after 118 inmates were killed during a [[riot]] at a prison in [[Guayaquil]] on 28 September. A [[government of Ecuador|government]] official said that some prisoners will be prioritized and that the main goal is to address prison overcrowding. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/death-toll-ecuadors-worst-ever-prison-riot-rises-118-2021-10-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Second Berejiklian ministry]]
**[[New South Wales]] [[Premier of New South Wales|Premier]] [[Gladys Berejiklian]] announces her [[resignation]] after the [[Independent Commission Against Corruption (New South Wales)|Independent Commission Against Corruption]] revealed that they are investigating her over a series of suspicious historical community grants. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-10-01/icac-investigating-gladys-berejiklian-daryl-maguire/100506956 (ABC News Australia)]
*[[2021 Georgian local elections]]
**Exiled Georgian politician [[Mikheil Saakashvili]] announces that he is back in [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] despite threats by [[Prime Minister of Georgia|prime minister]] [[Irakli Garibashvili]], who said that Saakashvili would be "immediately arrested and brought to prison" if he returned. Saakashvili, in his support for the [[United National Movement (Georgia)|United National Movement]], concluded by saying that "I risked my life and freedom to be back". Saakashvili is arrested later in the day. [https://www.dw.com/en/georgias-exiled-ex-president-saakashvili-says-he-is-back-in-country-ahead-of-elections/a-59373706 (Deutsche Welle)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/georgian-ex-leader-says-he-is-back-home-despite-jail-threat-authorities-deny-2021-10-01/ (Reuters)]
